sections.heading: Planning your Tanjong Tree Residences @ Hougang interior
sections.text:
Hougang Street 13 sits in a mature north-eastern town. Owners who are close to keys usually want a first fit-out that can start as soon as the permit is in hand: a fitted kitchen, full-height wardrobes, an entry shoe cabinet, and a living-room storage wall, designed from the approved plan rather than from a guessed layout. Maison specifies built-in carpentry, not flat-pack furniture, and we can work in a wide room view or in closer shots of a wardrobe or a kitchen run. No official floor plan is on file, so typologies and room sizes are not listed.

Kovan Wellspring is the other Hougang page in this batch; a tracker month for that project was withdrawn, and it should not be used as a date guide for Tanjong Tree. We will not invent walking times to Hougang town, to Kovan, or to any MRT station. Check your block, facing and the HDB renovation rules before you plan blinds, a bench or any hacking.

After keys, inspect defects, measure, and obtain the HDB renovation permit before fabrication. A moderate, non-structural carpentry scope is often planned at six to ten weeks on site after access and approvals, as an editorial figure only. WhatsApp Maison with your approved plan and any key letter you have. We are not affiliated with HDB.
